video.title: All-Day Stock in 15min, No Bones Required (ft. James Hoffmann)
video.author: Chris Young

note: Frank's real scribbles from his second hands-on test (2026-11-26), at the times he wrote them. He was noting a recipe.

scribbles.text: make veal or beef stock from ground meat instead of bones.  more meat flavor
brown the whole block of ground meat first, if you break it up it will release too much liquid.  burner can't keep up.
use vegetables sparingly so it doesn't taste like vegetables, should taste like meat.
drain oil once the meat is nice and browned.  add vegetables (carrot, onions, celery, etc).
add powdered gelatin and some water to thicken to make up for missing bones
add an egg yolk and more water into a blender, blend. then add meat mixture into it.  pulse until it's broken into small pieces, not into a smoothie.
pour back into a pot and let it simmer, add additional flavorings if needed.  bay leaves, peppercorns. cover lid to overcook the raft.  strain with a big coffee filter.
traditional demiglace is made with veal and not beef or chicken.  veal is kind of neutral but meaty in flavor
